name: trendsetter
description: Cross-browser social content collector with SQLite storage and pluggable RAG research APIs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trendsetter/shared && npm run build -w @trendsetter/server && npm run build -w @trendsetter/extension
scripts.check: npm run build -w @trendsetter/shared && npm run check -w @trendsetter/server && npm run check -w @trendsetter/extension
